metaDescription: Turn a title into a lowercase URL slug with hyphens or underscores.
intro: Turn a title into a lowercase URL slug with hyphens or underscores.
aboutTitle: How does a title become a URL slug?
about: A slug is the part of a URL that names a page. The generator cleans the input and joins the remaining words with your selected separator.
exampleTitle: Create a slug for a draft article
example: Enter “How to Plan an SEO Audit” and select hyphens. Review the result in your CMS before publishing.

faqs.question: Will generating a new slug redirect an old URL?
faqs.answer: A redirect has to be configured on the website that serves the existing URL. Use Redirect Checker after you apply it.
